NBA:nba.late_game_script.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.late_game_script.reason: Cover-flip frequency by spread needs historical pregame spreads: no permitted source (odds vendors paid, no Kalshi spread history). FT%/foul-by-score parts buildable from PBP, but whole input not.

NBA:nba.rotation.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.rotation.reason: No coach identity column anywhere (needed for coach-level pooled priors); collect coach-by-team-game via ESPN public endpoints. Stints/PBP otherwise cover stint length, sub time, margin bins.

NBA:nba.teammate_absence_shift.history: 3 seasons player_games (>=8-game absences in last 2 seasons)
NBA:nba.teammate_absence_shift.reason: minutes, usage (fga+.44fta+tov), reb/ast shares from player_games; absence via played/minutes<5/dnp_reason; opp rating, rest, home from team_games. Prior games only; role-model shrink derived from same columns.

NBA:nba.teammate_conv.reason: Needs NBA.com leaguedashptstats passing/tracking (potential assists, shot-type eFG): not on permitted list; PBP assist credit gives only completed assists, not potential assists.

NBA:nba.frontcourt_competition.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.frontcourt_competition.reason: Rebounds by player from PBP rebound events (p1) joined to on-court five from stints; opp ORB% from team_games oreb + player dreb sums; minutes from player_games. Stints are prior games. Non-null shares of PBP/stints not re-read.

NBA:nba.tip_first_shot.reason: Opening-play type (ATO) has no column; play-type data is Synergy-style/paid. Shot-taker, tip winner and first FGA are buildable; the ATO component is not.

NBA:nba.first_basket_share.reason: First made basket per team/game from shot_events ordered by period, clock_seconds_remaining, sequence with shot_made/points_value; lineup from prior-game started flags. Tonight's own started flag not used.

NBA:nba.onoff.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.onoff.reason: Lineup/on-off net rating from stints pts/poss with opponent adjustment from team_games; use certified stints only; minutes threshold from seconds. Prior games only. Stints not re-read for shares.

NBA:nba.series_model.reason: Series reconstructed by team pair/season/playoff type; ratings from regular season + prior playoff games; injury adaptation uses injury_report_rows (2025-10..2026-06 vintage only, 1 postseason): adjustment calibration is thin.

NBA:nba.playoff_rotation.reason: Ratio of playoff to regular-season minutes per player from minutes, started, season_type; rotation depth = count of >=10 min; margin/pace from team_games. Only 3 postseasons so role-bucket pools are small but buildable.

NBA:nba.sos_remaining.history: 3 seasons results; schedule capture archive since 2026-09
NBA:nba.sos_remaining.reason: Future schedule from the owner's schedule capture; ratings from team_games prior games; opponent availability from injury report snapshot at issue time. History for backtest: schedules derivable from team_games.

NBA:nba.injury_risk_season.reason: Hazard by age, position, prior injury: no age/position/DOB columns. Collect roster age/position via ESPN public roster endpoint; injury type history only 1 season.

NBA:nba.minutes_scenario_mixture.reason: Needs 3+ seasons PBP (have ~2) and 'coach-announced restriction' regime (no column; injury reason text partial, 1 season). Backfill ESPN PBP for 2023-24 and capture restriction notes.

NBA:nba.lineup_conditional_component_rat.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.lineup_conditional_component_rat.reason: Per-player AST by on-court partner set needs assist credit (p2/text semantics unverified) joined to stints; PTS/REB feasible. Need confirmation of assister field and stint date coverage.

NBA:nba.own_game_environment.reason: Points = pace x opp-adjusted rating from team_games pts/opp_pts/possessions/home with EWMA; active-set delta from minutes and prior games; tonight's availability applied at runtime from injury capture, not history.

NBA:nba.first_possession_chain_prob.reason: First possession team = team on first non-jump-ball event; first-trip score via scoring_play/score_value before opponent possession; jump-ball winner from type_text assumed; 15-game half-life fine. Prior games only.

NBA:nba.early_game_usage_first6.reason: FGA+0.44FTA and made-FG share in first 6:00 of Q1 from shot_events (period=1, clock_seconds_remaining>=infinity-360, is_free_throw); starters from prior games' started flag; renormalise over tonight's expected starters at runtime.

NBA:nba.first_shot_type_make_prob.reason: Type = zone (rim/corner3/above-break/mid) with distance_ft, x/y (79.8% non-null; zone 100%); first FGA per team-game from event order; make rate by shot_made; opp zone allowed via opponent_team_id.

NBA:nba.starting_five_continuity.reason: Core is 'exact tonight's five': tonight's pregame starters need vintaged capture (starters archive only since 2026-09/10); as-played started flags of the game itself would be post-game. History counts of prior games OK.

NBA:nba.roster_overlap_weighted_rating.reason: Overlap weights from player_games minutes/played of past games; ratings from team_games margin/opp-adjust; lambda fit on 3 seasons using trailing-minute projections as proxy for tonight's minute shares (not as-played). Preseason prior from prior season.

NBA:nba.margin_heteroscedasticity.reason: Specifies 5 seasons of team-games; real data has 3 (+2 months). Backfill 2021-22 and 2022-23 final scores/possessions from ESPN public scoreboard/boxscore endpoints.

NBA:nba.series_game_conditional_state.history: 3 postseasons results; injury vintage only 2026 playoffs
NBA:nba.series_game_conditional_state.reason: Injury-status change since game 1 needs vintaged pregame injury reports; only one postseason (2025-26) exists (~80 games). Needs prospective injury capture across playoffs; rest/elimination/margins buildable.

NBA:nba.ot_period_distribution.reason: Asks 15 seasons of OT/period counts; have ~3. Backfill via ESPN scoreboard linescores for 12 earlier seasons.

NBA:nba.bench_minutes_distribution.reason: Bench minutes = 240+25*n_ot - starter minutes from minutes/started/n_ot; bench ppm from pts/minutes of non-starters with 30-game half-life; scenario weights from own margin model. Tonight's starters from pregame capture at runtime.

NBA:nba.starter_bench_definition_ledger.reason: Needs pregame vintage of expected and official starter lists per team-game; history holds only as-played started flags (post-game, not PIT). Collect from owner's starters capture; short history.

NBA:nba.team_stat_pair_difference_model.reason: Team 3PA/3PM (sum of player_games by team-game), FTA, possessions; opp-adjusted rates with 20-game half-life; NB dispersion and between-team count correlation from 3 seasons of team-games.

NBA:nba.three_point_variance_load.reason: 3PA, 2PA (=fga-fg3a), FTA, makes by team from player_games; possessions from team_games; total residuals from pts+opp_pts. As-of tipoff via prior games.

NBA:nba.ot_final_margin_pmf.reason: 15 seasons of OT games needed; ~200 OT games here. Backfill earlier linescores from ESPN public scoreboard.

NBA:nba.within_team_allocation_dependenc.reason: Player points per game by team, availability from played/minutes; partial correlation given team points; shrink to role-pair prior built from the same data. Prior games only.

NBA:nba.on_court_assist_share.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.on_court_assist_share.reason: Needs assist credit joined to on-court lineups (assisted FGM while on court); assister field (p2/text) and stints coverage not verified. Total AST available only game-level.

NBA:nba.team_assisted_fgm_expectation.reason: Team assisted FGM = sum of player ast (an assist = one assisted FGM); FG% from player fgm/team fga; assisted rate and scheme adjustment via opponent-allowed rates; EWMA 20 games. Prior games only.

NBA:nba.heavy_minutes_tail_prob.reason: Share of games with minutes>=38 over last 80 games; own-model closeness from team ratings; role prior from started/minutes. Tonight's role at runtime.

NBA:nba.fga_per_minute_by_shot_type.reason: 2PA=fga-fg3a, 3PA, FTA per 36 from player_games; shrink to role-position mean using started/minutes-derived role (position column absent; derived role). Teammate shift from #teammate_absence_shift.

NBA:nba.ft_trip_structure_model.reason: Needs post-touch counts (tracking) absent from data and only on non-permitted NBA.com tracking; foul-trip/bonus structure from PBP and rim attempts from shot_events is buildable but post touches are not.

NBA:nba.intentional_foul_target_prob.reason: Intentional-foul labelling depends on type_text/text values not shown; 'ball-handler role' needs a role label; PBP ~2 seasons not 3. Need type_text value list.

NBA:nba.pair_difference_correlation.reason: 5 seasons of player-game stats required; have 3. Backfill 2021-22, 2022-23 ESPN boxscores (permitted ESPN endpoints).

NBA:nba.playoff_matchup_assignment_shift.reason: leagueseasonmatchups (NBA.com stats) not in data and NBA.com stats is not a permitted source; no defender-assignment column.

NBA:nba.dd_category_pair_mix.reason: Position/role archetype prior has no column (no position/archetype in player_games). Collect positions via ESPN roster endpoint; per-category pts/reb/ast/stl/blk and minutes buckets otherwise fine.

NBA:nba.dd_center_swap_share.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.dd_center_swap_share.reason: TRB%/AST% by lineup with ridge on/off requires per-stint rebound and assist attribution from PBP (assist field unverified) and min 150 possessions with ~2 seasons; coverage unmeasured.

NBA:nba.usage_allocation_model.reason: Creation archetype (on-ball minutes share) is tracking-derived, absent and from non-permitted NBA.com tracking; stint FGA/FTA/TOV by five on-court players otherwise buildable from PBP+stints.

NBA:nba.cross_player_points_dependence.reason: Residual points vs minutes-conditional expectation from player_games, same/opposite team pairs; Fisher-z shrinkage to position-pair prior built from derived roles. Prior games only.

NBA:nba.points_upper_tail_rate.reason: Exceedances over minutes-conditional mean on >=30-minute games; GPD fit; all columns present for 3 seasons.

NBA:nba.player_xpts_per_shot.reason: ACTION_TYPE (layup/pullup/etc.) has no column in shot_events; may be parsed from event_type/PBP text but values unverified. zone/x/y/distance/shot_made/shooter present.

NBA:nba.creditable_rebound_pool.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.creditable_rebound_pool.reason: Team rebounds and out-of-bounds recoveries are not in box columns; need PBP type_text coverage of team-rebound/OOB events (unverified). Live FT misses from shot_events is_free_throw.

NBA:nba.pairing_adjusted_reb_share.history: stints ~2 seasons; CV on prior season
NBA:nba.pairing_adjusted_reb_share.reason: Needs per-stint rebounds and opponent misses joined from PBP; stint date coverage unmeasured and only ~2 seasons for rolling-origin CV on previous season.

NBA:nba.three_make_by_openness_prior.reason: Closest-defender openness splits are tracking data (NBA.com), not in data and not permitted; pull-up flag lacks column. Corner/above-break base cells are buildable from zone.

NBA:nba.three_att_script_elasticity.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.three_att_script_elasticity.reason: 3PA from shot_events (points_value=3) with margin from PBP running scores at event_id; minutes per margin bin from stints cumulative pts; prior games only; margin paths from team ratings not spread.

NBA:nba.assisted_three_passer_map.history: PBP ~1.27M rows, stints 83k rows (~2 seasons est.; date range not measured: schema-only)
NBA:nba.assisted_three_passer_map.reason: Assist credit for threes (p2 vs text) not verified; passer-availability probabilities from injury capture at runtime.

NBA:nba.period_margin_pmf.reason: 5 seasons of linescores asked; 3 held. Backfill ESPN linescores 2021-22, 2022-23.

NBA:nba.period_possession_split.reason: Period FGA/FTA from shot_events, OREB/TOV by period from PBP type_text; possessions per quarter by standard formula; 50-game half-life. Event type labels assumed, not verified.

NBA:nba.first_passage_race_table.reason: Needs 5 seasons PBP running scores; have ~2 (shot_events ~3). Backfill ESPN PBP and starters' first-stint rating from stints.

NBA:nba.opening_stint_unit_rating.reason: First-8-minute lineup points/possessions from stints period 1; modal five from prior started flags; shrink to team full-game rating. Tonight's five from runtime capture.

NBA:nba.leader_share_by_usage_rank.reason: 5 seasons of box scores required; have 3. Backfill ESPN boxscores 2021-22/2022-23.

NBA:nba.star_pair_scoring_correlation.reason: Top-3 scorers per team and cross-team pair residual correlations; availability from played. Prior games only.

NBA:nba.streak_hit_persistence.reason: Threshold hit from pts, minutes projection, rest from game_date_et, opponent defensive rating from team_games, lag-1 hit; DNP via played/dnp_reason. Injury status not needed beyond played.

NBA:nba.single_game_margin_pmf.reason: 5 seasons of margin residuals asked (have 3); Cup group schedule/flag has no column. Backfill ESPN scoreboard + NBA Cup schedule from capture.

NBA:nba.live_ball_turnover_profile.reason: Live vs dead-ball needs turnover type_text and steal credit (p1/p2) not verified; player_games.stl gives steal totals only.

NBA:nba.stocks_dependence_by_archetype.reason: Archetype labels (guard/wing/forward/center) have no position column. Collect positions via ESPN roster endpoint.

NBA:nba.four_factors_matchup.reason: Four factors per 100 possessions: eFG from player_games fgm/fg3m/fga sums, TOV, ORB% (oreb vs opp dreb), FTR; opponent-adjust iteratively with opp_team_id; prior games only.

NBA:nba.single_game_ceiling_tail.reason: Exceedances over 35 pts incl OT, season-to-date max from prior games; all columns present.

NBA:nba.team_three_attempt_matchup.reason: Team 3PA per 100 poss (sum player fg3a / possessions); opponent-allowed index from opp_team_id; player shares from fg3a. Prior games only.

NBA:nba.multi_game_ml_pack_model.reason: Leg P(win) from own ratings + home + rest; joint = product; dependence test from realised results. Availability adjustment calibrated on 1 season of vintaged injuries only.

columns_used: none in tables (exhibition possession data absent)
NBA:nba.target_score_race_model.history: ASG target-score format only since 2021 (~6 events)
NBA:nba.target_score_race_model.reason: Exhibition possession-level scoring not in tables (season_type may exclude ASG); tiny sample. Collect ASG PBP via ESPN public endpoints.

NBA:nba.series_sum_stopping_simulator.reason: Series id/game number reconstructed from season_type + team pair + date; period points incl OT present; series random effect from 3 postseasons; projected lineups at runtime.

NHL:nhl.score_state.history: MoneyPuck shots 2008-2020 (1.37M) + recent (605k rows; seasons not measured) ; nhl_shots 2021-26
NHL:nhl.score_state.reason: Shot attempts/xGoal with running score (homeTeamGoals/awayTeamGoals) and time give per-60 by score state; time-in-state from goal times. xGoal is MoneyPuck's published model output (check model vintage); prior games only.

NHL:nhl.period_split.reason: Period goals/shots from shots tables (period, goal, teamCode/team_id); league shape per season and team deviations. Final per-period shot counts, all prior games.

NHL:nhl.shootout_record.reason: Shooter-level SO conversion/goalie SO save% not in tables (shot tables and skater_games exclude shootout attempts; only last_period_type). Collect from NHL public gamecenter play-by-play (shootout events).

NHL:nhl.ixg_player.reason: Shooter xGoal by strength from skater counts on ice and shooterPlayerId; TOI by EV/PP from toi_ev_s/toi_pp_s; opponent xGA by position via skater position. EWMA over 40-60 games. xG is third-party model output.

NHL:nhl.pk_structure_opp.reason: Opp PK SOGA/60, xGA/60 from situation=4on5 team rows; point-share from nhl_shots x,y/zone at strength; player PP shot role from sog_pp, toi_pp_s. Prior games only.

NHL:nhl.game_script_prob.reason: Lead/trail state probabilities by simulation from own team ratings (market line optional); calibrated against historical score states from shots/goals. No data gap.

NHL:nhl.ot_3v3_rate.reason: 3v3 goals via period=4, skaters on ice=3 per side in shots tables; OT minutes from goal time/game end; star OT TOI shares from toi_ot_s (2021-26).

NHL:nhl.first_goal_hazard.reason: Goals in first 5/10 min via period=1 time/t_s with goal flag; first-goal team from goal times; home flag and goalie terms from goalie_games.

NHL:nhl.long_change_effect.reason: Period-2 goals/xGoal by team vs league baseline, home/away split from shots tables; shrink heavily.

NHL:nhl.career_trajectory.reason: Age-curve needs birth date/age: no age column in skater_games. Collect birthDate from NHL public player landing endpoint (permitted).

NHL:nhl.joint_outcome_correlation.reason: Game-level latent pace/script/goalie and empirical joint frequencies from historical logs; all columns present.

NHL:nhl.ot_sudden_death_hazard_5v5.history: 2008-09+ (~330 playoff OT games est.) vs 2005-06 asked
NHL:nhl.ot_sudden_death_hazard_5v5.reason: Playoff OT goal times with skaters on ice (5v5) and tied xG rates from isPlayoffGame shots; exposure = elapsed OT minutes to game end. 2005-08 absent, minor reduction in sample; no PIT issue.

NHL:nhl.series_ot_count_dependence.reason: Series reconstructed from playoff game_type, team pair, season; OT via last_period_type; pregame tie prob from own model. 2005-08 not held (about 15% fewer series).

NHL:nhl.tied_late_risk_posture.reason: 5v5 attempts/high-danger (xGoal or location) in final 5:00 when tied vs minutes 40-55 tied via time/score fields; standings leverage from games. Prior games only.

NHL:nhl.prior_to_current_blend.reason: Age term has no column (no DOB/age); collect from NHL public player landing endpoint. Prior ratings, roster moves with TOI and results are present.

NHL:nhl.pair_attempt_volume.reason: 5v5 attempts and TOI per team-game, home flag, score-adjusted attempts present; Poisson regression with team/opponent effects; prior games only.

NHL:nhl.opp_sog_for_rate.reason: SOG for/against by 5on5/5on4/4on5 and TOI by state; score-differential adjustment from shots running score or scoreVenueAdjusted columns; 40-game half-life.

NHL:nhl.ot_shot_exposure.reason: OT shots per 3v3 minute and goalie save probability from shot rows with goalieIdForShot and OT period; OT length from goal time; regulation tie prob from own model.

NHL:nhl.period_entry_state_matrix.reason: Period-by-period goals/SOG, margin at period start from cumulative goals; goalie pulls via homeEmptyNet/awayEmptyNet/shotOnEmptyNet. Prior games only.

NHL:nhl.period_pair_count_model.reason: Period goal counts per team from goal flags by period; team strength and PP expectations from moneypuck_team_games and team_states; sufficient history.

NHL:nhl.period_home_ice_split.reason: Period goals and 5v5 xGoal (xGoal, skaters on ice) by home/away from shot rows; strength estimates from ratings; season FE.

NHL:nhl.skater_en_usage.reason: EN goals and EN TOI are present, but assists in EN intervals and EN direction (own pull vs opponent pull) are not in columns. Collect NHL public PBP goal events with assists/situationCode.

NHL:nhl.skater_ot_3v3_exposure.reason: OT points rate needs assists in OT; skater_games has totals only and shots give goals only. Collect NHL public PBP (assists in period 4 goals). 3v3 minutes available from toi_ot_s.

NHL:nhl.sog_share_on_ice.reason: Team SOG while player is on ice needs shift-level on-ice data; skater_games gives only own sog and on-ice goals. Collect NHL public shift charts + PBP (permitted NHL JSON).

NHL:nhl.copula_tail_dependence.reason: Rank transforms of result, margin, total, SOG, points, saves across game logs; all five seasons held. Prior games only.

NHL:nhl.rating_posterior_uncertainty.reason: Score-adjusted xG and goal differential per team-game with schedule; state-space fit with preseason prior from prior season. xG published model output.

NHL:nhl.loser_point_rate.reason: Regulation/OT/SO results from last_period_type and home_win; beyond-regulation rate and win-given-extra by team-season. All present.

NHL:nhl.series_goalie_volatility.reason: Goalie saves/shots/GSAx per playoff game from shot rows with goalie id and xGoal; series results from games; excess variance over binomial. xG published model output.

NHL:nhl.win_streak_extremum_dist.reason: Game result sequences by team; rating posterior from moneypuck_team_games; simulation needs no extra column.

NHL:nhl.series_state_scoring_shift.reason: Series score entering each playoff game reconstructed from prior results; total goals incl OT in nhl.games.total; rating-implied mean from prior-game ratings; venue from home team.

NHL:nhl.series_game_dependence.reason: Game outcome with lagged result/series score from nhl.games; pre-series rating from regular-season moneypuck_team_games; home flag. All present.
